co_m1_ob1.text: Bloodhound has docked. Sweep the landing bay and get through the security gate to the inner perimeter. You'll need your tech to bypass the door locks.

co_m1_ob2.text: Good work, we have the flight data. The lift to the lower level is past flight control. Get your squad to the exit.

co_m1_ob3.text: That's the cargo lift ahead. Get everyone aboard.

co_m1_ob7.text: The cargo elevator at the end of this section is your way down to the colony. Move.

co_m1_ob8.text: You're down. Get to the exit, the colony is through there.

co_m2_getaccross.text: She can't hold there long. Get across, now!

co_m2_ob1b.text: Gate's open. Take the catwalks north to the pump station, and watch the drop.

co_m2_onback.text: The last span is down. She's bringing herself in over the gap: you'll cross on her back.

co_m2_pipeline.text: The miners wired the main pipe with charges before they were overrun. Get to the detonator and finish the job.

co_m2_powerout.text: Power's gone on the bridge ahead. It'll be dark out there.

co_m2_start.text: This is Deima. The swarm is using the colony's main pipeline as a highway between the hives. Find that pipe and shut it down.

co_m2_stayinlight.text: Bloodhound will run alongside and light the way. Stay inside her lamps.

co_m3_ob1.text: This is the Rydberg plant. Get to the reactor core and bring the power back up: the colony's running on batteries.

co_m3_ob2.text: Reactor's online, power is coming back across the colony. Don't stop now, keep moving.

co_m3_ob3.text: Squad, listen. We've lost the colony. Command is drawing up a plan to nuke the site from orbit. Get through the north doors and head for the residential sector.

co_m5_almost.text: Nearly there. A few eggs left, keep looking.

co_m5_elevator.text: That's the lot. Get to the elevators and call one down.

co_m5_more_bio.text: More biomass in the mall. Bullets won't touch it: use the flamer.

co_m5_ob1.text: This is the SynTek residential block, eggs and biomass right through it. Burn the growth, smash every egg, then get to the elevators.

co_m5_parasite.text: Careful round those eggs: whatever hatches goes straight for a marine.
